disagreement.independent_candidate: Quench heat about 760 to 780 C; tempering must be selected by required properties, with low, medium and high educational bands disclosed separately.
disagreement.legacy_candidate: Quench heat about 770 C and a recommended general temper range of 150 to 650 C.

source_review.finding: The supplied Fe-C equilibrium diagram supports A1=727 C and therefore a quench-heating estimate near A1 plus 30 to 50 C. It contains no tempering-property curve and cannot select one recommended temper interval.

review_reasoning: 727 plus 30 to 50 C gives 757 to 777 C, rounded to about 760 to 780 C or 770 C.
Tempering is performed below A1, but the actual temperature is selected for the required hardness, strength and toughness balance.
The legacy 150 to 650 C span is acceptable only as a broad educational envelope, not as one source-derived recommendation.
The independent answer preserves the useful bands while marking the missing design requirement explicitly.
reviewed_exam_answer_ru: Отпуск проводят ниже A1; общий учебный диапазон 150–650 °C делят на низкий, средний и высокий, а конкретную температуру выбирают по требуемому сочетанию твёрдости и вязкости. По одной диаграмме Fe–C единственный режим определить нельзя.
